name: Survive & Protect
text: You are all survivors from daemonic incursions, your former allies killed. You have banded together after retreating, forming a diverse group to investigate local wrongdoing.
enemies: Threats to the local area: Mutants, a villainous Scum gang, a small Chaos cult.
note: Example Frameworks table. Its Tier 2 and 3 rows are the patron Frameworks Varonius Vanguard and Fylamon’s Finest (creation/patrons/core.json).

name: Radical Inquisitor Conclave
text: Dispatched by a radical Inquisitor, your strike force is the spear tip in a counter-attack against Chaos. Bouncing from one Warp-torn frontline to another, you battle daemons on a daily basis, attempting to find a way back through the Great Rift to the safety of Imperium Sanctus.
characters: Radical Inquisitors will employ anyone to get the job done; especially when isolated and unobserved by the wider Imperium.
enemies: Threats to the Gilead System: Daemon princes and their forces, champions of Chaos, undocumented xenos, an Ork WAAAGH!
